title: Wildheart site at design-handoff fidelity: the six screens composed from registered blocks, dressed by the skin alone

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-12: the published site 'needs about 600 design passes to be anywhere near what we designed'; then: 'This space is an in house space. Use the notes to create a full site, that ties in perfectly with the theme. Make sure there's nothing hand rolled.'

detail:
The live Wildheart site (theme `wildheart`, LIVE-902) changed colours and fonts but not the composition: the hero was a text block over a half-arch photo, body type small and grey with empty gaps, cards flat, the CTA band a dark rectangle, none of the handoff's ornaments, seals, moons, zodiac marks, photo frames or vellum gradients. This row brings it to the handoff (design_handoff_wildheart/templates/website/Website.dc.html: Home, The program, The year, Circles, Retreat, About) in screenshot-proven passes, under the owner's rules: every page composed only from registered page-editor blocks, every look from the theme skin and the `--wh-*` tokens, the Space's own rows drawn by the live blocks (SpaceEvents, SpaceCommunity, SpacePractices and the season band read the 57 seeded events, the circle and the two journeys at render time), the stock theme's defaults still generic and gender-neutral.

PASS 1 (composition and rhythm): the skin re-dresses every page section the Frequency sheet draws (components/sites/wildheart-css.ts, the `.mw-*` rules under `[data-house-site][data-house-theme="wildheart"]` so they outrank that sheet without !important): the 1200px frame, 48px gutters, 96px section gaps, the handoff type scale (display XL 108/0.98 to XS 26, body 19/1.65, labels 11px tracked caps), arch and petal photo frames with the warm grade and grain, petal cards on washed vellum, the ornament rule on section heads, the lavender closing band. Eight composition blocks registered in `wildheartComponents` for the pieces no generic block carries (components/page-editor/blocks/wildheart.tsx): WildheartOrnament (moons, star, phases, the 'enter the year' bridge), WildheartPhoto (arch / petal / circle / rect, warm or dusk, caption, credit, watermark glyph), WildheartMoonPath (steps as a moon waxing new to full), WildheartSealCards (a seal per card), WildheartSeasonBand (the module now from the block's twelve, the next gathering with its beats, the next dated days, in the season's colours, dates from the Space's events), WildheartRetreatBand (dusk photo, seal, watermark, day tiles, two buttons, note, bleeding full width), WildheartMarkSplit (the Space's own logo beside the words, the About shape), WildheartMoonStrip. Primitives WhOrnament, WhSeal, WhMoonPhases beside WhGlyph and WhMoon. The seed's six page docs rewritten to the handoff's order (scripts/seed-wildheart.mts; Safety folded into The program and hosting into Circles because MAX_PROFILE_PAGES is six); the handoff's five photos under public/brand/wildheart/photos. A Wildheart site's Home now renders its page doc through the same sections as every page (components/sites/site-page.tsx `wildHome`). The shared section renderer gained two theme-neutral marks: `data-phase` on each journey week (the week's moon) and flat journeys (a week per phase) listed as weeks; the circle finder's seat label is no longer 'men'. Footer: the Space's mark and the star ornament. Harness: test/wildheart-site.render.test.tsx renders the seed's pages through SiteChrome + MensworkPage + BlockRender with the seed's rows (the Next page needs the database and next/font); scripts/probes/wildheart-shots.mjs screenshots them at 1440 and 390 beside the handoff's screens. Theme CSS 57,949 bytes before this row, 105,241 after pass 1 (the budget in the probe is 128KB).

Pass 1 shipped: the skin re-dresses every page section, eight composition blocks, the six page docs, the render harness and the screenshot runner. Passes 2 and 3 (components; signature pieces) append below.

PASS 2 (components): every dated row's mark is the day's moon (the shared section renderer stamps `data-phase` on each date mark, the skin draws the phase; the kind colours the ring: season ink for a Circle Night, madder for the retreat); the hero carries a 7% watermark of the sign now (the chrome stamps `data-sign` on the site root, twelve skin rules pick the glyph); the closing band is the handoff's vellum-on-dusk band with a smoke and madder wash, a hairline and the spark mark; kickers lose the house dot (the handoff's labels are plain); on a phone the header becomes the logo and a 44px Menu / Close pill, the sub-bar keeps season, sign and moon and drops the house and the next-event line. Theme CSS 109,154 bytes after pass 2.

PASS 3 (signature pieces and the last visible differences): the retreat band bleeds to the 1200px frame as the handoff's does (the section wrapper that holds it drops its gutters); a watermark glyph is positioned and faint inline, so the editor canvas and the Space page never show a 300px glyph in the flow; the hero kicker reads in the muted ink. Confirmed against the lead's pass-3 reference (wildheart-design-passes/pass-3-signature.html, section 'Three pages'): the hero split with the arch photo, the enter-the-year bridge, the four parts with roman numerals, the moon path, the season band's three cards (now, next gathering, next in the sky), the story with its photo. Theme CSS 109,220 bytes after pass 3. REMAINING, by design or out of reach here: the handoff's YearJourney (a sticky wheel that turns under a needle as the page scrolls) stays the CSS scroll strip (no client JS reachable from the site chrome); its mobile composition (SkyMap compact, the four-way 'how would you like to arrive' choice) is not a page doc; the handoff's hand-drawn icon stand-ins on the four parts are the spark mark; the account pill and the auto-hiding header are not in the chrome; the handoff's Website.html could not be screenshotted in this sandbox (its React bundle pins the headless renderer; unpkg is blocked, React and Babel were vendored from the npm registry and routed) so the side-by-side used the lead's static pass-3 page; host names and photography are the owner's.
